user.title: Set up TTLock BLE
user.description: Choose how this Home Assistant gets the keys for your locks.

menu_options.cloud: Sign in to a TTLock account

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up TTLock BLE
bluetooth_confirm.description: **{name}** was found over Bluetooth. Its address and protocol header are already known; what is still missing are its keys, which live either in a TTLock account or in whatever provisioned the lock locally.

menu_options.cloud: Sign in to a TTLock account

cloud.title: Set up TTLock BLE
cloud.description: Enter your TTLock cloud credentials. They are used once to download the per-lock keys; after that, lock/unlock runs offline over Bluetooth.

manual.title: Enter a lock key manually
manual.description: For a lock initialised outside the TTLock cloud. Enter the values your local setup produced; they are stored on this entry and used directly over Bluetooth, with no account involved. The AES key accepts either continuous hex or separated bytes. The five protocol numbers form the frame header the lock expects — the defaults suit most V3 locks, and if the lock is in range the first three are checked against what it broadcasts.

verify_code.title: Verify your TTLock account
verify_code.description: TTLock sent a one-time code to your email. Enter it below to register this Home Assistant install as a trusted device.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate TTLock BLE
reauth_confirm.description: Your credentials are no longer valid. Enter the updated credentials.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure TTLock BLE
reconfigure.description: Update the credentials for this entry. Keys will be re-synced from the cloud.

reconfigure_manual.title: Update the lock key
reconfigure_manual.description: Correct the values stored for this lock. No cloud account is involved.

error.connection: Unable to reach the TTLock cloud.
error.invalid_code: The verification code was not accepted. Please try again.
error.verification_required: TTLock requires verifying this device. Re-add the integration to complete the flow.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC address in the form AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_aes_key: The AES key must be 16 bytes of hex.
error.invalid_unlock_key: The unlock key must be digits only.
error.invalid_admin_passcode: The admin passcode must be digits only.
error.protocol_mismatch: The lock is broadcasting a different protocol type, version or scene than the one entered. Check the values against your lock data.
error.lock_not_in_account: This account holds no key for the lock that was found. Sign in with the account that owns it, or enter its key manually.

abort.already_configured: This lock or account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The credentials entered belong to a different TTLock account. Re-authenticate with the account this entry was created from.
abort.not_a_lock: This Bluetooth device is not a TTLock lock.

data_description.permanent_connection: Hold a BLE session open and reopen it the moment it drops. Off, the lock is connected to only to run a command or to read records it says it has; state and battery come from its advertisements, which cost no session at all. On, commands answer immediately, at the cost of the lock's battery.
